decisions.reason: As a close extension of the core fluid-handling range, it likely remains above a tolerable aspiration threshold under the firm's growth and investment conditions, so management would keep it while monitoring uncertain market traction.

Because the hydrocyclone coolant filter builds directly on the firm's established filtration capabilities and supports its one-stop offering, the expected fit and available organisational slack make continued retention more likely than withdrawal.

The gravity band coolant filter is closely related to the firm's existing filtration business, and in an expanding firm in a growing industry management would usually continue such a product unless clearer evidence of persistent underperformance emerges.
